abstract: PINO combines operator learning with physics-informed training for parameterized PDEs and zero-shot super-resolution.
title: Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Learning Partial Differential Equations

abstract: FourCastNet applies adaptive Fourier neural operators to global high-resolution data-driven weather forecasting.
title: FourCastNet: A Global Data-driven High-resolution Weather Model using Adaptive Fourier Neural Operators
venue: PASC '23: Proceedings of the Platform for Advanced Scientific Computing Conference

abstract: Derivative-informed neural operators learn both parametric PDE maps and their derivatives, using low-rank compression to reduce derivative-data and training costs.
title: Derivative-Informed Neural Operator: An efficient framework for high-dimensional parametric derivative learning

abstract: Orthogonal polynomial neural operator with exact treatment of nonperiodic Dirichlet, Neumann, and Robin boundary conditions.
title: Render unto Numerics: Orthogonal Polynomial Neural Operator for PDEs with Nonperiodic Boundary Conditions

abstract: Pangu-Weather uses 3D Earth-specific neural networks for fast and accurate medium-range global weather forecasting.
title: Accurate medium-range global weather forecasting with 3D neural networks

abstract: RelaxNet is a structure-preserving neural network surrogate for the Boltzmann collision operator with positivity, conservation, invariance and H-theorem preserving design.
title: RelaxNet: A structure-preserving neural network to approximate the Boltzmann collision operator

abstract: A foundation model for weather and climate using heterogeneous geophysical data and task adaptation.
title: ClimaX: A foundation model for weather and climate

abstract: Transformer-inspired neural operators and out-of-distribution risk bounds for Helmholtz forward maps.
title: Out-of-distributional risk bounds for neural operators with applications to the Helmholtz equation

abstract: Latent Spectral Models reduce high-dimensional PDE data into compact latent tokens and apply neural spectral blocks to learn multiple basis operators for PDE-governed tasks.
title: Solving High-Dimensional PDEs with Latent Spectral Models
venue: ICML 2023 / Proceedings of Machine Learning Research

abstract: ADMM separates nonsmooth regularization from smooth PDE-constrained optimization in a PINN framework.
title: The ADMM-PINNs Algorithmic Framework for Nonsmooth PDE-Constrained Optimization: A Deep Learning Approach

abstract: CHGNet is a pretrained graph neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling of materials.
title: CHGNet as a pretrained universal neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling

abstract: General neural operator transformer for irregular meshes, multi-scale problems and heterogeneous operator learning tasks.
title: GNOT: A General Neural Operator Transformer for Operator Learning

abstract: LNO embeds pole-residue structure in the Laplace domain to model non-periodic signals, transient responses and large-scale ODE/PDE solution operators.
title: Laplace neural operator for solving differential equations

abstract: AI model based on Fourier neural operator accelerates in-flow bacterial dynamics simulation and supports fluid-mechanics-driven device geometry design.
title: AI-aided geometric design of anti-infection catheters

abstract: Derivative-informed neural operators accelerate PDE-constrained optimization under high-dimensional uncertainty.
title: Efficient PDE-Constrained Optimization Under High-Dimensional Uncertainty Using Derivative-Informed Neural Operators

abstract: Distributed operator learning across heterogeneous input-function subsets and sensor layouts.
title: D2NO: Efficient handling of heterogeneous input function spaces with distributed deep neural operators
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: Multigrid neural operator parameterization for efficient and regularized learning of PDE solution operators.
title: MgNO: Efficient Parameterization of Linear Operators via Multigrid

abstract: Differentiable neural representations combined with meshfree partition-of-unity discretization and variational residual formulations.
title: Neural-Integrated Meshfree (NIM) Method: A differentiable programming-based hybrid solver for computational mechanics
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: Super-fidelity maps low-fidelity solutions to high-fidelity warm starts with an equivariant vector-cloud neural operator, accelerating steady-state CFD while retaining iterative-solver accuracy.
title: Neural operator-based super-fidelity: A warm-start approach for accelerating steady-state simulations

abstract: MACE-MP foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry and stable molecular dynamics across diverse materials systems.
title: A foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry

abstract: Boundary-embedded neural operators for elliptic PDEs with complex geometries and inhomogeneous boundary conditions.
title: BENO: Boundary-embedded Neural Operators for Elliptic PDEs

abstract: Transolver introduces Physics-Attention, slicing discretized meshes into learned physical-state tokens to obtain a fast transformer PDE solver on complex geometries.
title: Transolver: A Fast Transformer Solver for PDEs on General Geometries
venue: ICML 2024 / Proceedings of Machine Learning Research

abstract: DNO maps varying physical domains to a generic domain through diffeomorphisms, enabling a single neural operator to generalize across geometry, size, resolution and parameters.
title: Diffeomorphism neural operator for various domains and parameters of partial differential equations

abstract: Operator learning method using unsupervised pretraining and in-context learning for improved data efficiency and generalization.
title: Data-Efficient Operator Learning via Unsupervised Pretraining and In-Context Learning

abstract: OmniArch performs unified 1D, 2D and 3D pretraining on PDEBench, combines a Fourier encoder-decoder, transformer dynamics backbone and PDE-Aligner, and supports in-context and zero-shot adaptation to new physics.
author_statement: Tianyu Chen, Haoyi Zhou, Jianxin Li et al.（北京航空航天大学）
contribution_summary: 提出首个面向多尺度、多物理科学计算问题并强调"物理对齐"的基础模型原型，在 PDEBench 上完成 1D–2D–3D 统一预训练，刷新多项维度基准，并展示对未见物理场景的强上下文/零样本适应能力。
method_summary: 预训练阶段采用 Fourier 编码器-解码器消解不同空间维度间的表征鸿沟，配合 Transformer 骨干沿时间维度整合物理量演化；引入新颖的 PDE-Aligner 模块，在灵活条件下执行物理知情微调，实现跨方程/跨维度对齐。
research_relation: 作为"科学计算基础模型"范式的早期代表性尝试（2024年2月，先于本仓库已收录的 MPP、UPT、DPOT 等多数里程碑工作），OmniArch 验证了统一架构联合预训练跨维度 PDE 的可行性，其零样本/上下文适配新物理系统的实证结果为后续基座模型工作提供了先导性证据；ICML 2025 正式接收（改标题为 "Building Flexible Machine Learning Models for Scientific Computing at Scale"），是本仓库 `docs/LANDMARK_MODELS.md` 应补录的重要早期基座模型。
title: OmniArch: Building Foundation Model for Scientific Computing

abstract: DPOT combines autoregressive denoising pretraining with scalable Fourier attention, reaching 0.5B parameters on more than ten PDE datasets and over 100,000 trajectories.
title: DPOT: Auto-Regressive Denoising Operator Transformer for Large-Scale PDE Pre-Training

abstract: CoDA-NO tokenizes functions along the codomain or channel dimension and enables self-supervised multiphysics pretraining and few-shot transfer across coupled PDE systems.
title: Pretraining Codomain Attention Neural Operators for Solving Multiphysics PDEs

abstract: DDELD constrains the information scope used for local neural-operator predictions so that network dependency respects locality and finite propagation in PDE systems.
title: Enforcing the principle of locality for physical simulations with neural operators

abstract: SNF-ROM combines smooth grid-free neural fields with Galerkin projection and automatic differentiation for nonlinear reduced-order dynamics of advection-dominated PDEs.
title: SNF-ROM: Projection-based nonlinear reduced order modeling with smooth neural fields

abstract: A multiscale operator-transformer foundation model pretrained on large-scale fluid-dynamics data and evaluated on 15 downstream PDE tasks, including unseen physics.
title: Poseidon: Efficient Foundation Models for PDEs

abstract: Latent neural operator framework for forward and inverse PDE problems using latent representations and physics-cross-attention.
title: Latent Neural Operator for Solving Forward and Inverse PDE Problems

abstract: RINO learns continuous input/output dictionaries with implicit neural representations so operator models can accept arbitrary sensor counts and locations during training and inference.
title: A resolution independent neural operator
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: PROSE-PDE jointly models symbolic equations and numerical trajectories, learns multiple one-dimensional nonlinear time-dependent PDE operators and extrapolates to unseen equations or data.
contribution_summary: 提出PDE无关的元学习算法LeMON，为多算子学习基座模型提供更优的参数初始化，使模型在仅少量新算子族样本微调后即可预测未见算子，甚至实现零样本预测。
method_summary: 在多个PDE算子族上进行分布式预训练，引入MAML式元学习目标改善跨算子适应性；同时探索LoRA低秩适配以降低下游微调的计算成本。
research_relation: 从"训练策略"层面补足基座模型下游少样本/零样本迁移能力，与已收录的DeepONet多算子外推、PROSE-PDE同属UCLA/FSU团队多算子基座路线的互补进展。
title: Towards a foundation model for partial differential equations: Multioperator learning and extrapolation

abstract: VINO trains neural operators without labels by minimizing a discretized variational energy, reducing the cost of evaluating physics-informed losses at increasing mesh resolution.
title: Variational Physics-informed Neural Operator (VINO) for solving partial differential equations
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: VICON uses patch-wise vision-transformer in-context operator learning for dense two-dimensional multiphysics fluid data, flexible timestep strides and robust deployment under missing or irregular measurements.
author_statement: Yadi Cao et al.（UCLA / 新加坡国立大学 / UC San Diego）
contribution_summary: 将视觉 Transformer 的分块（patch-wise）处理引入 In-Context Operator Networks（ICON），解决原始 ICON 逐点 token 化在高维稠密数据上效率低下的问题，同时保留跨多物理系统、跨不同时间步的上下文自适应能力；在三个流体动力学基准上相较 DPOT 降低37.9%、相较 MPP 降低44.7%的末步 rollout 误差，推理耗时仅为二者的72.5%/34.8%。
method_summary: 视觉 Transformer patch 化表征 + In-Context 算子学习框架，支持灵活时间步跨度的 rollout 策略；已被 TMLR 2026 接收。
research_relation: 直接对标并超越两个已收录的基座模型基线（DPOT、MPP），验证"高效 token 化 + 上下文算子学习"路线在多物理场景下的可扩展性，并在真实世界不完美测量场景下展现远优于基线的鲁棒性（性能衰减24.4% vs 基线71-74%）。
title: VICON: Vision In-Context Operator Networks for Multi-Physics Fluid Dynamics Prediction

abstract: A PINN solves a parametric adjoint relativistic Fokker-Planck problem for runaway-electron density dynamics.
title: A physics-constrained deep learning treatment of runaway electron dynamics

abstract: The framework combines DeepONets, physics-informed residuals and variational Bayesian training for PDE solution, parameter estimation and aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty quantification.
title: Deep operator networks for Bayesian parameter estimation in PDEs

abstract: PCNO learns parametric PDE solution operators directly on point clouds representing complex and variable geometries, adaptive meshes and topology changes.
title: Point cloud neural operator for parametric PDEs on complex and variable geometries
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: Neural operator preconditioner accelerates Krylov solvers for sparse linear systems arising from PDE discretizations.
title: Neural Preconditioning Operator for Efficient PDE Solves

abstract: Predictive uncertainty estimates for neural operators are used to drive active learning in input function spaces.
title: Active operator learning with predictive uncertainty quantification for partial differential equations

abstract: PODNO replaces fixed Fourier transforms with POD-derived orthonormal transforms for high-frequency, oscillatory and dispersive PDEs.
title: PODNO: Proper Orthogonal Decomposition Neural Operators

abstract: PITA is a self-supervised temporal-alignment framework that constrains dynamics across time steps and improves long-horizon and out-of-distribution behavior of autoregressive PDE foundation models.
author_statement: Congcong Zhu et al.（中国科学技术大学 SCAILab；ICML 2025）
contribution_summary: 针对自回归 PDE 基座模型普遍存在的"捷径学习"导致误差累积问题，提出物理知情时间对齐（PITA）自监督框架，显著提升现有基座模型在多类时变 PDE 数据上的精度与鲁棒性，尤其是分布外（OOD）长时程场景。
method_summary: 受逆问题求解启发，将物理约束嵌入自监督信号，对同一 PDE 轨迹在不同时间步发现的物理动力学进行对齐；对齐过程不依赖已知物理先验，可作为插件应用于已有自回归基座模型（如 DPOT 等）之上。
research_relation: 直接解决自回归 rollout 类基座模型的核心痛点（长时程误差累积/捷径问题），且方法与具体骨干解耦、可迁移至多种现有基座模型，对提升基座模型的长时程可靠性与 OOD 泛化具有普遍参考价值；已被 ICML 2025 接收,方法论上具代表性。
title: Physics-informed Temporal Alignment for Auto-regressive PDE Foundation Models

abstract: GAOT combines multiscale attentional graph neural operator encoders and decoders, geometry embeddings and transformer processors for efficient PDE operator learning on arbitrary domains, including large-scale 3D industrial CFD datasets.
title: Geometry Aware Operator Transformer as an efficient and accurate neural surrogate for PDEs on arbitrary domains

abstract: A scalable transformer backbone for regular-grid physics simulations, pretrained across 16 PDE types with channel-wise spatiotemporal tokens and improved transfer over training from scratch.
contribution_summary: 提出PDE-Transformer，将扩散Transformer（DiT）的架构改进与大规模物理仿真结合，在16类PDE数据集上超越所有现有视觉Transformer基准。引入"通道级时空token"编码策略：每类物理量作为独立token，通过通道注意力实现跨场相互作用，保持多物理PDE同时学习时的信息密度均匀性。
method_summary: DiT-style架构适配 + 通道分离token嵌入 + 多PDE类型联合预训练；可作为大规模PDE基础模型的骨干网络（已在HuggingFace发布预训练权重）；接受ICML 2025。
title: PDE-Transformer: Efficient and Versatile Transformers for Physics Simulations

abstract: HyDEA combines DeepONet-predicted line-search directions with CG/PCG refinement for pressure-Poisson solves, retaining iterative robustness while improving cross-geometry and cross-resolution acceleration.
title: Hybrid deep learning and iterative methods for accelerated solutions of viscous incompressible flow

abstract: ENMA is a generative neural operator for time-dependent parametric PDEs. It encodes irregular observations into a uniform latent space and uses flow-matching-trained masked autoregression for tokenwise future generation, supporting in-context conditioning and one-shot surrogate modeling.
author_statement: Armand Kassaï Koupaï, Lise Le Boudec, Louis Serrano, Patrick Gallinari et al.（Sorbonne Université / CNRS-ISIR / Criteo AI Lab）
contribution_summary: 提出ENMA，一种生成式神经算子，在压缩潜空间内使用生成式掩码自回归Transformer与流匹配损失实现逐token随机生成，支持推理时以少量上下文轨迹对新PDE制度进行in-context学习与one-shot代理建模，已在NeurIPS 2025发表。
method_summary: 注意力机制将不规则采样空间观测编码为均匀潜表示，再经时空卷积编码器压缩；生成式自回归Transformer在潜空间中产生联合概率分布（而非确定性预测），通过流匹配损失训练；推理时可条件化于目标轨迹过去状态或同类辅助轨迹，实现零样本参数制度外推。
title: ENMA: Tokenwise Autoregression for Continuous Neural PDE Operators
title_zh_summary: ENMA生成式神经PDE算子逐token自回归+in-context学习（Sorbonne，NeurIPS 2025，补录：2025年6月）

abstract: CWP-PINN replaces isolated pointwise residual weighting with spatially coherent convolutional neighborhood weights derived from a primal-dual optimization view.
title: Convolution-weighting method for the physics-informed neural network: A primal-dual optimization perspective

abstract: An open-source PyTorch differentiable SPH framework supports compressible, weakly compressible, and incompressible flows, inverse problems, optimization, and solver-network hybridization.
title: diffSPH: Differentiable smoothed particle hydrodynamics for hybrid machine learning solutions in fluid mechanics

abstract: SC-NO constructs deep neural operators by repeatedly composing a single parameter-efficient backbone, inspired by fixed-point, multigrid and domain-decomposition solvers, and uses an adaptive train-and-unroll curriculum to resolve high-frequency and multiscale PDE structure.
title: Self-composing neural operators for high-frequency and multiscale PDE surrogates

abstract: Self-supervised neural operator generates training data on the fly using a physics-informed sampler and learns PDE solution maps without solver-generated labels.
title: Self-supervised neural operator for solving partial differential equations
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: HyPINO maps PDE parameterizations to target PINNs using a Swin Transformer hypernetwork, combines manufactured-solution supervision with physics-informed unlabeled training, and targets zero-shot solution of broad two-dimensional elliptic, hyperbolic and parabolic PDE families with varying sources, geometries and mixed boundary conditions.
author_statement: Rafael Bischof et al.（ETH Zurich, Computational Design Laboratory）
contribution_summary: 提出 HyPINO——一种面向广谱 PDE 的多物理神经算子，无需任务特定微调即可零样本泛化到椭圆、抛物、双曲型二维方程（含多种几何、混合 Dirichlet/Neumann 边界及内部边界），在七个 PINN 文献基准上超越 U-Net、Poseidon 与 PINO；NeurIPS 2025 接收。
method_summary: 以 Swin Transformer 超网络将 PDE 参数化映射为目标 PINN 的权重，混合监督来源——manufactured solutions（MMS）生成的带标签解析数据与物理信息目标驱动的无标签样本；并提出将残差视为"delta PDE"进行二次前向传播的迭代精化机制，最优情形下 L2 误差降低超100倍。
research_relation: 直接对标 Poseidon、PINO 等基座模型基线，验证了"超网络生成任务特定求解器"这一路线在跨方程零样本泛化上的可行性，为基座模型的零样本适配范式提供了另一条不依赖大规模端到端预训练的路径。
title: HyPINO: Multi-Physics Neural Operators via HyperPINNs and the Method of Manufactured Solutions

abstract: P3D is a scalable three-dimensional neural surrogate architecture combining local convolutional processing with global Transformer context. It is trained on manageable 3D crops and deployed at substantially larger spatial resolutions, targeting transferable modeling of large-scale 3D physical simulations.
title: P3D: Highly Scalable 3D Neural Surrogates for Physics Simulations with Global Context

abstract: DRIFT-Net couples a global low-frequency spectral branch with a local image branch to improve long-horizon PDE rollout stability while reducing parameters relative to windowed-attention baselines.
title: DRIFT-Net: A Spectral-Coupled Neural Operator for PDEs Learning

abstract: MoE-POT uses sparse routed and shared experts to scale PDE operator pre-training from 30M to 0.5B parameters across six public PDE datasets while controlling activated inference cost and improving zero-shot performance.
author_statement: Hong Wang et al.（中国科学技术大学 MoE 脑启发智能感知与认知重点实验室）
contribution_summary: 提出稀疏激活的 MoE 算子 Transformer，解决多类 PDE 数据集异质性导致的混合训练高误差问题，在控制推理成本的同时实现参数高效扩容；90M 激活参数模型相对 120M 参数的现有模型零样本误差降低达40%。NeurIPS 2025 接收。
method_summary: 逐层路由门控网络在16个专家中动态选择4个路由专家以捕捉方程特异特征，另设2个共享专家提炼PDE间的共性、减少路由专家间冗余；在6个公开PDE数据集上预训练30M–0.5B参数规模模型。
research_relation: 直接针对基座模型"多物理混合预训练时精度-成本权衡"这一核心痛点，MoE 稀疏路由为规模化预训练提供了可扩展范式，对标 DPOT/NESTOR 等同类工作。
title: Mixture-of-Experts Operator Transformer for Large-Scale PDE Pre-Training

abstract: NOWS uses learned neural-operator predictions as warm starts for Krylov iterative solvers, preserving classical solver convergence while reducing iteration counts and end-to-end runtime by up to 90 percent across multiple discretization families.
title: NOWS: Neural Operator Warm Starts for accelerating iterative solvers
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: Continuous Flow Operator learns continuous-time PDE dynamics by flow matching spline-derived velocity fields, supports irregular temporal sampling and arbitrary-time inference, and improves long-horizon stability.
author_statement: Xianglong Hou, Xinquan Huang, Paris Perdikaris（宾夕法尼亚大学）
contribution_summary: 将流匹配（Flow Matching）重新定位为PDE右端项学习工具——通过拟合轨迹样条的有限差分导数构建训练速度场，无需反向传播穿越ODE求解器；天然支持非均匀时间网格，实现时间分辨率不变的神经算子训练
method_summary: CFO（连续流算子）框架；样条拟合轨迹→有限差分导数作为流匹配速度场；FNO骨干；非均匀时间采样验证
title: CFO: Learning Continuous-Time PDE Dynamics via Flow-Matched Neural Operators
title_zh_summary: CFO：流匹配学习PDE连续时间动力学、时间分辨率不变（补录：2025年12月）

abstract: RealPDEBench benchmarks scientific machine-learning models on paired real-world and simulation data from complex physical systems, enabling evaluation of sim-to-real gaps, robustness and generalization beyond clean synthetic PDE benchmarks.
author_statement: Peiyan Hu, Haodong Feng, Tailin Wu et al.（Westlake University，ICLR 2026 Oral）
contribution_summary: 首个将真实世界实验测量数据与配对数值仿真数据对齐的科学机器学习基准，开源 736 组真实+仿真配对数据，涵盖 5 个数据集、3 项任务、8 个指标、10 个基线模型，直击当前科学 ML 模型"只在仿真数据上训练评测"的长期痛点。
method_summary: 构建跨多类复杂物理系统的真实-仿真配对数据集；定义支持 sim-to-real 迁移研究的三项任务；实验揭示仿真与真实数据间存在显著差异，但仿真数据预训练可稳定提升真实数据上的精度与收敛性。
research_relation: 为 PDE 基座模型的"最后一公里"——从仿真泛化到真实物理系统——提供了首个标准化评测基础设施，是基座模型走向实用部署前必须跨越的验证关卡。
title: RealPDEBench: A Benchmark for Complex Physical Systems with Real-World Data

abstract: PFEM pretrains a Transolver-based physics-informed neural operator without labeled solutions on unstructured point clouds and uses its predictions to warm-start linear and nonlinear FEM solvers, with generalization across geometries, materials, boundary conditions and resolution.
author_statement: Yizheng Wang et al.（清华大学 / 包豪斯魏玛大学 / 汉诺威莱布尼茨大学）
contribution_summary: 提出 PFEM 框架，用纯物理信息（无标签数据）预训练的神经算子为经典有限元求解器提供高质量初值，在保持 FEM 精度、收敛性与外推能力的同时大幅减少迭代次数。
evaluation_pdes: linear and nonlinear solid-mechanics PDE benchmarks
method_summary: 预训练阶段采用 Transolver 架构的神经算子，直接在非结构点云上联合编码几何、材料属性与边界条件，仅由控制方程监督训练；热启动阶段将预测解作为 FEM 初始猜测。在线弹性/非线性超弹性、复杂几何、非均匀材料等基准上验证，预训练阶段相对误差约1%，微调阶段相比传统FEM提速可达一个数量级。
research_relation: 展示了"物理信息预训练 + 经典数值求解器"这一混合范式作为基座模型能力的替代/互补路径，为基座先验与数值求解器耦合提供了具体且可复现的实现。
title: Pretrain finite element method: A pretraining and warm-start framework for PDEs via physics-informed neural operators
venue: Journal of the Mechanics and Physics of Solids

abstract: A physics-guided diffusion sampling method augments generative PDE models with PDE-residual and observational guidance and embeds the procedure in Sequential Monte Carlo, forming a scalable generative solver tested on multiple benchmark, multiphysics and interacting PDE systems.
author_statement: Andrew Millard, Fredrik Lindsten, Zheng Zhao（Linköping University / Uppsala University）
contribution_summary: 提出粒子引导扩散模型用于PDE求解——将PDE残差与观测约束作为物理引导信号，嵌入顺序蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样框架，构建可扩展的生成式PDE求解器；在多类PDE基准系统以及多物理耦合与交互PDE系统上，生成解场的数值误差全面低于已有生成式方法的最优水平。
method_summary: Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) 粒子框架 + 扩散模型采样；PDE残差 + 边界/观测约束作为物理引导；支持多物理耦合与交互PDE系统；生成式求解，无需可微传统求解器。
title: Particle-Guided Diffusion Models for Partial Differential Equations

abstract: This method combines latent diffusion with physics-informed inference in scaled spectral representations, reducing dimensionality while retaining function-space regularity required by PDE operators. It addresses forward, inverse and data-assimilation settings under partial observations.
author_statement: Davide Gallon, Philippe von Wurstemberger, Patrick Cheridito, Arnulf Jentzen（ETH Zürich；补录：2026年2月）
contribution_summary: PISD 在**缩放谱表示空间**中训练潜扩散模型，并在推断时通过逐步 Adam 更新将 PDE 约束与测量条件作为**硬约束**注入每个扩散步，无缝统一正向与逆向 PDE 问题。
method_summary: 傅里叶/谱域潜空间训练 LDM；推断时逐步自适应 Adam 步长强制 PDE 残差约束；处理任意不完整观测下的逆问题。
title: Physics-Informed Diffusion Models in Spectral Space

abstract: Physics-informed Laplace neural operator combines Laplace-domain operator learning with physics-informed constraints for solving time-dependent PDEs without relying exclusively on labeled solution data.
author_statement: Heechang Kim, Qianying Cao, Hyomin Shin, Seungchul Lee, George Em Karniadakis, Minseok Choi et al.（Brown University，Karniadakis 团队）
contribution_summary: 提出物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子（PILNO），将PDE残差、边界条件和初始条件嵌入 Laplace Neural Operator 的训练过程，在小数据 regime 和分布外泛化场景下显著优于纯数据驱动的 LNO。无需大量仿真数据即可构建精度可靠的 PDE 代理模型。
method_summary: Laplace 变换域内神经算子骨架 + 物理残差正则化联合训练；同时利用时域和频域双重监督信号；适配初边值问题的统一框架。
title: Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
title_zh_summary: 物理信息Laplace神经算子（Karniadakis团队）

abstract: CINOC formulates PDE control as operator learning from state fields to continuous control functions, trains through differentiable PDE solvers, and achieves cardinality-invariant transfer across changing sensor, actuator and multi-agent configurations.
author_statement: Pietro Zanotta, Dibakar Roy Sarkar, Honghui Zheng, Somdatta Goswami, Ján Drgoňa et al.
contribution_summary: 提出CINOC——将PDE控制重新表述为算子学习问题，实现基数不变（Cardinality-Invariant）神经算子策略：策略将状态场映射为连续控制函数，通过可微PDE求解器端到端训练。核心创新：在小规模系统上训练的策略可零样本迁移至显著更大规模的多智能体配置，同时对部分执行器失效表现出内生鲁棒性。
method_summary: 以神经算子（FNO基）参数化从状态场到控制策略的映射，统一不同数量传感器/执行器；可微PDE求解器提供梯度信号进行端到端策略优化；基数不变性通过函数空间连续表示自然实现，无需特殊架构设计；多智能体场景验证了零样本大规模迁移。
title: CINOC: Cardinality-Invariant Neural Operator Policies for Scalable PDE Control
title_zh_summary: CINOC基数不变神经算子策略零样本迁移大规模PDE控制

abstract: PGD-NO moves geometric encoding to deterministic precomputation and extracts reusable geometry tokens, decoupling feature extraction from solution queries. The resulting neural operator has linear memory scaling and is demonstrated on industrial meshes exceeding ten million nodes.
title: PGD-NO: A Neural Operator with Precomputed Geometry Decomposition for 3D Million-Scale Physics Simulations

abstract: Adaptive Mamba Neural Operators use Takenaka-Malmquist reproducing-kernel representations for state-space models to learn PDE solution operators across heterogeneous geometries and discretizations.
title: Adaptive Mamba Neural Operators

abstract: A staged PINN training strategy progressively increases coupled physics complexity for material degradation and fluid dynamics problems.
title: Multistage physics informed neural network for solving coupled multiphysics problems in material degradation and fluid dynamics

abstract: A DeepONet variant predicts stress fields in elastoplastic structures under variable complex geometries and loads.
title: Novel DeepONet architecture to predict stresses in elastoplastic structures with variable complex geometries and loads
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: I-PINNs use subdomain networks that share parameters but employ different activation functions to model sharp-interface PDEs with discontinuous coefficients and solutions.
title: Interface PINNs (I-PINNs): A physics-informed neural networks framework for interface problems
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: ICNO couples spectral- and spatial-domain information for computational mechanics and parametric PDE operator learning.
title: Information-Coupled neural operator for computational mechanics and parametric PDEs
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: The method partitions the domain into geodesic subdomains and progressively activates PINN supervision according to physical information flow, avoiding misleading gradients in causally unreachable regions.
title: A flow-aware training strategy for physics-informed neural networks
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: TRANSP integrated modeling code paper for interpretive and predictive tokamak plasma analysis.
title: TRANSP integrated modeling code for interpretive and predictive analysis of tokamak plasmas

abstract: GAPI-DeepONet encodes geometry in the branch input and uses a geometry-adaptive conditioning network to modulate trunk features layer by layer. It is evaluated on cylinder flow, NACA airfoil flow and a three-dimensional heat-sink problem under varying geometries.
title: A geometry-adaptive physics-informed operator framework generalized for arbitrary geometries

abstract: A residual-network surrogate predicts time-dependent NLTE absorption and emission spectra, ion populations and plasma states from density, temperature, radiation field and initial ionization distributions.
title: Deep learning surrogate models to solve time-dependent NLTE absorption and emission spectra

abstract: SONets decompose parametric PDE solution operators into learnable sub-operators, improving modular operator learning for parametric PDEs.
title: SONets: Sub-operator learning enhanced neural networks for solving parametric partial differential equations

abstract: f-PICNN combines convolutional architectures with physics-informed residual constraints over space-time domains for PDE solution learning.
title: f-PICNN: a physics-informed convolutional neural network for partial differential equations with space-time domain

abstract: The framework combines finite-volume discretization with graph neural networks to construct a PDE loss and learn parametric PDE solutions without precomputed paired data.
title: Learning to solve PDEs with finite volume-informed neural networks in a data-free approach

abstract: DGenNO uses weak-form physical residuals and deep generative latent-variable modeling for label-free forward and inverse parametric PDE learning with uncertainty representation.
title: DGenNO: a novel physics-aware neural operator for solving forward and inverse PDE problems based on deep, generative probabilistic modeling

abstract: DeepOMamba combines DeepONet with a Mamba state-space temporal model for efficient long-horizon and high-dimensional spatiotemporal PDE operator learning.
title: DeepOMamba: State-space model for spatio-temporal PDE neural operator learning

abstract: A physics-informed finite-element operator-learning approach preserves equilibrium and periodic boundary conditions for multiscale simulations.
title: EquiNO: A physics-informed neural operator for multiscale simulations

abstract: A Lagrange-multiplier optimization formulation builds on scalar-auxiliary-variable energy descent to obtain robust large initial learning rates for neural PDE solvers.
title: A machine learning method for solving PDEs with a robust initial learning rate based on Lagrange multiplier optimization

abstract: HyMeshAI combines CNN-based mesh-density prediction and ANN-based nodal positioning for end-to-end dynamic three-dimensional AMR mesh generation under irregular geometry and variable mesh size.
title: HyMeshAI: Deep learning enabled three-dimensional adaptive mesh generator for high-resolution atmospheric simulations

abstract: A noise-robust multi-index stochastic collocation surrogate is developed for parametric PDE quantities of interest when low-fidelity evaluations contain discretization, tolerance, or transient noise.
title: Noise-robust multi-fidelity surrogate modelling for parametric partial differential equations

abstract: Equation-recast neural operators provide minimal-data extrapolation and are embedded in iterative PDE solvers, including Boltzmann transport tests.
title: MD-PNOP: Equation-recast neural operators for minimal-data extrapolation and PDE solver acceleration

abstract: PGMNO combines linear multistep numerical integration, an implicit backward-differentiation-formula training scheme and structured state space models to improve the accuracy, efficiency and long-term stability of neural operators across diverse time-dependent PDE benchmarks, including resolution-invariant extrapolation.
title: PGMNO: A physics-Guided mamba neural operator framework for partial differential equations

abstract: MPNOT derives a multi-particle attention layer from multi-particle reaction-diffusion dynamical systems to improve local spatial modeling and interpretability in transformer-based neural operators, with evaluations on Burgers, reaction-diffusion, Navier-Stokes and Allen-Cahn equations.
title: Multi-particle neural operator transformer for solving partial differential equations

abstract: SV-PINO uses separation of variables to transform dynamic PDEs into families of lower-dimensional ordinary differential equations in eigenfunction or wavelet spaces, then learns their coefficients with neural operators. The construction targets spectral bias, high-order derivatives, complex boundary conditions and discrete systems without explicit PDE forms.
title: Separated-variable physics informed neural operators for solving dynamic PDEs

abstract: A physics-constrained neural surrogate estimates runaway-electron avalanche growth rates over plasma parameters.
title: A physics-constrained deep learning surrogate model of the runaway electron avalanche growth rate

abstract: A multi-fidelity Bayesian neural operator learns nonlinear stress-strain function maps for spinodal metamaterial design with uncertainty estimates.
title: A multi-fidelity Bayesian neural operator for mechanics of spinodal metamaterial

abstract: GNoME scales graph neural network models and active learning for materials discovery.
title: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery

abstract: NeuralGCM combines a differentiable solver for atmospheric dynamics with machine-learning components for weather and climate prediction.
title: Neural general circulation models for weather and climate

abstract: GenCast is a machine-learning model for probabilistic weather forecasting using generative ensemble prediction.
title: Probabilistic weather forecasting with machine learning

abstract: A review and perspective on neural operators for accelerating scientific simulations and design.
title: Neural operators for accelerating scientific simulations and design

abstract: A deep neural operator framework addresses PDEs whose computational domain or interface is part of the unknown solution.
title: Deep neural operator for free boundary problems

abstract: Local neural operators are extended from trajectory surrogates to equation-free fixed-point, stability and bifurcation analysis.
title: Enabling local neural operators to perform equation-free system-level analysis

abstract: The paper develops principled rules for lifting finite-dimensional neural architectures to function-space operator learners.
title: Principled approaches for extending neural architectures to function spaces for operator learning

abstract: NOEM combines reusable local neural operators with finite-element assembly for scalable multiscale PDE simulation.
title: NOEM: efficient and scalable finite element method enabled by reusable neural operators

abstract: XGBoost models trained on approximately 1500 ICP ignition experiments predict quartz-tube peak temperature and heating rate and quantify the importance of operating parameters.
title: Temperature prediction of high-temperature and high-enthalpy plasma generators based on machine learning

abstract: Review of machine-learning methods for tearing-mode interpretation, onset prediction, avoidance, suppression, and control.
title: A review of machine learning-driven studies of tearing modes in tokamaks

abstract: A spectral modal operator-learning framework decouples spatial and temporal representations to improve high-frequency and nonlinear modal dynamics for unsteady-flow surrogate modeling.
title: Spectral modal operator learning framework with decoupled spatial and temporal representations for unsteady flows

abstract: The Hermite neural operator uses Hermite spectral basis functions to learn PDE solution operators on unbounded domains. Its continuous outputs intrinsically satisfy far-field decay conditions and support stable off-grid inference beyond the training support, with demonstrations on heat and nonlinear Schrodinger equations.
title: Hermite neural operator for solving partial differential equations on unbounded domains

abstract: GraphCast uses graph neural networks for skillful medium-range global weather forecasting.
title: Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting

abstract: Finite-element coefficient-map operator learning for parametric elliptic PDEs with convergence analysis.
title: Finite Element Operator Network for Solving Elliptic-Type Parametric PDEs

abstract: This work develops and evaluates physics-informed DeepONets for forward and inverse PDE problems on unknown manifolds represented only by sampled point clouds. It combines diffusion maps or generalized moving least squares with operator learning and embeds the learned forward surrogate in Bayesian MCMC for coefficient inversion.
physical_domains: unknown manifolds represented by point clouds
publisher: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics
title: Solving Forward and Inverse Partial Differential Equation Problems on Unknown Manifolds via Physics-Informed Neural Operators
training_pdes: linear and semilinear diffusion-type PDEs on manifolds

abstract: Multiscale neural networks are used to approximate low-regularity Green’s functions, with Barron-space analysis showing reduced network size and faster training for fixed-operator PDE solvers.
title: Multiscale Neural Networks for Approximating Green’s Functions

abstract: A neural-network framework combines tearing-and-interconnecting domain-decomposition ideas for scalable PDE solution.
title: Neural Network Tearing and Interconnecting Methods for PDEs

abstract: RINN adds a covariance-driven orthogonalization and preconditioning stage to physics-informed extreme learning machines, reducing initialization sensitivity before least-squares enforcement of PDE constraints.
title: Rank-Inspired Neural Network for Solving Partial Differential Equations

abstract: An unsupervised physics-informed neural operator models optical-fiber light propagation across configurations.
title: Fast and Generalizable Light Field Propagation Modelling in Optical Fiber by Physics-Informed Neural Operator

abstract: Theoretical study of how PDE order affects convergence behavior in physics-informed neural networks.
title: How does PDE order affect the convergence of PINNs?

abstract: Latent PDE modeling method using local neural fields to preserve spatial structure.
title: AROMA: Preserving Spatial Structure for Latent PDE Modeling with Local Neural Fields

abstract: Study of conditional diffusion models for PDE simulations and posterior sampling.
title: On conditional diffusion models for PDE simulations

abstract: Large-scale collection of diverse physics simulations for machine learning, benchmarking and scientific foundation models.
title: The Well: a Large-Scale Collection of Diverse Physics Simulations for Machine Learning

abstract: Mamba-based neural operator with alias-free design for efficient operator learning.
title: Alias-Free Mamba Neural Operator

abstract: Operator learning approach for accurate optical field simulation in complicated photonic devices.
title: PACE: Pacing Operator Learning to Accurate Optical Field Simulation for Complicated Photonic Devices

abstract: PDE-preserved coarse correction network for efficient prediction of spatiotemporal dynamics using high-order numerical schemes, boundary-condition encoding and neural correction.
title: P2C2Net: PDE-Preserved Coarse Correction Network for efficient prediction of spatiotemporal dynamics

abstract: Space-time continuous PDE forecasting with equivariant neural fields.
title: Space-Time Continuous PDE Forecasting using Equivariant Neural Fields

abstract: Newton-informed neural operator that learns nonlinear PDE solution mappings by incorporating Newton-like iterative structure.
title: Newton Informed Neural Operator for Solving Nonlinear Partial Differential Equations

abstract: Generative PDE-solving method under partial observation using diffusion models.
title: DiffusionPDE: Generative PDE-Solving under Partial Observation

abstract: HNO introduces hyperbolic geometry into neural-operator attention to represent hierarchical near/far interactions, borrowing the routing intuition of fast multipole methods. It is evaluated on six PDE benchmarks and two large unstructured CFD tasks.
title: Hyperbolic Neural Operator

abstract: Geometry-informed neural operator combines local graph kernels and global operator learning for large-scale 3D PDEs on complex geometries.
title: Geometry-informed neural operator for large-scale 3D PDEs

abstract: DeltaPhi reformulates neural PDE solving as residual learning between nearby physical states, providing architecture-agnostic implicit data augmentation and improving data efficiency across regular and irregular domains, architectures and resolutions.
title: DeltaPhi: Physical States Residual Learning for Neural Operators in Data-Limited PDE Solving

abstract: RNO uses the Riesz transform to combine global spectral information with local directional derivatives, improving sensitivity to non-stationary PDE structure and generalization across benchmark PDEs and real-world datasets.
title: Riesz Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations

abstract: Benchmark suite for evaluating neural PDE solvers across standardized PDE tasks and metrics.
title: PDEArena: A benchmark suite for neural PDE solvers
